description: Client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11, built on Baritone: gathers blocks or a schematic's materials, crafts and smelts them, stores them in your chests, builds, and walks back home.

mods.name: Haulback
mods.description: Va chercher les blocs que tu choisis (ou les materiaux d'un schematic), les ramene dans ton coffre et revient au point de depart. Base sur Baritone.

releases.notes:
**Install alongside:** Fabric API and [baritone-api-fabric-1.17.0.jar](https://github.com/cabaletta/baritone/releases/tag/v1.17.0) (the API build, not standalone).

### New
- **Automatic workshop**: places a crafting table and furnaces next to your chests, then smelts (glass, stone, bricks, ingots...) and crafts (planks, sticks, stairs, slabs, panes...) everything a schematic needs, fuel included.
- **Iron and diamond pickaxes**: when the target blocks require them, the bot mines iron and coal, smelts the ingots and crafts the pickaxe, then a diamond one if needed.
- **Schematic modes**: Materials only, Build only (from your chests), or Both.
- **Start/stop**: `K` key and the `/haulback` command (`start`, `stop`, `toggle`, `status`, `open`, `chest add|list|clear`). All keys are rebindable in Options > Controls.
- **Translations**: interface, HUD and chat messages in English and French, following the game language.

### Fixed
- The last broken block is now always picked up before heading back.
- When a block cannot be placed in its exact orientation from any reachable spot, the builder uses the closest orientation instead of stalling.

mods.name: Haulback
mods.description: Va chercher les blocs que tu choisis (ou les materiaux d'un schematic), les ramene dans ton coffre et revient au point de depart. Base sur Baritone.

releases.notes:
First release of Haulback for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, client-side only).

**Install alongside:** Fabric API and [baritone-api-fabric-1.17.0.jar](https://github.com/cabaletta/baritone/releases/tag/v1.17.0) (the API build, not standalone).

- Gathers chosen blocks or a schematic's materials (`.litematic`, `.schem`, `.schematic`)
- Multiple chests, with automatic deduction of what is already in stock
- Builds the schematic using blocks from your chests
- Crafts missing tools (tool selection and material in the Options tab)
- Survival: eats, retreats when low on health, fights hostile mobs (including skeletons at range)
- Human-like camera, returns to the starting point, configurable maximum radius

Keys: `H` opens the interface, `J` adds or removes the chest you are looking at.
